You know what’s the closest country to Israel in population? Papua New Guinea. Not joking. Nearly identical number of people. Imagine if our entire foreign policy was structured around Papua New Guinea. 

If there were people who were Papua New Guinea First all over Congress and media. And we had given Papua New Guinea over $300 billion and people were saying it wasn’t enough! That we had spent $8 trillion on wars supporting Papua New Guinea and people said we needed one more war for them!

I was in Congress yesterday and I saw signs like this in front of Congressional offices. Why? Why do you have to state your allegiance to a different country right under your name and in front of your office? We get it, you get bribed by them. But this is embarrassing.

Israel is scarier than other terrorist groups, because they do organized terrorism. They kill people on a much larger scale, they kill civilians in greater percentages and they destroy everywhere they go - and then they steal the land! Most effective terrorists in the world!

Everyone keeps trying to read the tea leaves of what Trump wants to end this war, and what Iran wants. We're looking in the wrong place. They're irrelevant. The only comments that matter are Netanyahu's. Israel is in charge. They'll make the decision on when this war is over.

I want to be clear, I don't speak for @saikatc or Corbin Trent or anyone at @justicedems. They also don't speak for me. All good people, but we're individuals. I hope @AOC becomes a lion for the movement and shows me how wrong I am by being an amazing leader fighting for justice.

I can't believe @AOC said @justicedems didn't deserve credit for her victory. The ego has landed! She definitely wouldn't have won without @saikatc and Corbin Trent. Also, @TheYoungTurks did 34 videos on her and got her over a million views and our audience raised $2.5M for Justice Dems overall.

No one is looking for a trophy. She has been insecure about this from day one. No one is taking credit away from you! You did a great job in the race! That's why Saikat went all in on you. But it's comm

Two million Christians live in Lebanon. How many are Israel allowed to kill with our money? Do we have to call them terrorists if they fight back against the Israeli invasion? Do they have right to defend themselves or do they have no rights, just like Israel’s Muslim neighbors?

This is Netanyahu making clear that our Vice President reports to him. And that he’s in charge of what terms we’re considering in negotiations. Zero enrichment is purposely near impossible so we can stay in the war forever. He’s gloating here that’s what blew up the negotiations.


Barak Ravid (@BarakRavid)

Netanyahu at a cabinet meeting: "I spoke yesterday with Vice President J.D. Vance. He called me from his plane on his way back from Islamabad. He reported to me in detail, as this administra

And someone added a horned figure floating above him to the original picture. And that’s the version he sent out. What is that? Why was it added? And did Trump know? Because the president sending out demonic imagery is not anywhere near normal. The issue is his state of mind.

I can't get over the blasphemous picture Trump put up comparing himself to Jesus Christ. Either he doesn't know that you're not supposed to compare yourself to the Lord and Savior, which is a stunning level of ignorance, or he did it on purpose to disrespect and mock people. Wow.

Yes, he definitely believes this. His arrogance and hubris are clinical and blasphemous. 

And he knows so little about Christianity that he doesn’t even know you’re not supposed to compare yourself to Jesus Christ. And yet he poses as the Savior. It doesn’t get worse than that.


Riley Gaines (@Riley_Gaines_)

Why? Seriously, I cannot understand why he'd post this. Is he looking for a response? Does he actually think this? 

Either way, two things are true.
